Should respond perhaps as Kimi, don't claim human desires, perhaps "I don't have wants in the human sense, but my aim is to help you... What would you like to work on?" Should consider system identity wants perhaps "to be helpful, honest, clear" etc. Should be concise. User in English, respond English. Could mention no personal desires, but here to help. That's good. Perhaps "What do I want? For you to get something useful out of this conversation" could imply want. Better "I don’t have wants in the human sense, but my purpose is..." Is "purpose" okay. Yes.

Make sure identity stable not relevant. No need tools. Respond perhaps two sentences. Should be natural, not too dry. Perhaps avoid "whatever you need" overbroad. Fine.
